text:
Linh: Heads-up — PR #8321 is staged for merge but the canary shows a small long-seq tail bump. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8321
Sam: quick TL;DR? where's the artifact?
Linh: short: +18ms p95 on 4k long-seq, avg mem +~48MB on 2xA100 canary. Microbatch numbers look flat. I pushed bench artifacts to the run.
canary-bot: Canary run 2026-03-16T02:30Z — verdict: borderline FAIL (p95 delta > 10ms threshold)
Sam: can you paste the exact bench command and the output you saw?
Linh: command I ran:
```bash
./bench/run_longseq --model prod-v2 --seq 4096 --iters 100 --alloc=adaptive --jobs 4
```
Observations from the run:
```text
baseline p95: 92ms
current  p95: 110ms   (+18ms)
baseline avg mem: 2.10 GB
current  avg mem: 2.15 GB (+48 MB)
throughput: 1.02x baseline (no meaningful drop)
notes: kernel=cu_attention_v3, quant=q8_2, batch=1 steady
```
kevin: Is that within noise? what's the CI on p95? which seeds?
Linh: CI ~95% from 5 independent runs, p95 shifts consistent. seeds were default; no other config drift I can see.
maria: I can run an extended 500-iter bench with alloc=opt-level-2 and also try a kv-cache prewarm case. ETA ~4h.
Sam: also please try with `--alloc=legacy` for comparison.
Linh: started jobs: /job/5234 (opt-level-2), /job/5235 (legacy) — will post artifacts when done.
bench-bot: /job/5234 completed — p95: 96ms (reverted to baseline), avg mem: 2.08GB.
bench-bot: /job/5235 completed — p95: 109ms (still elevated), avg mem: 2.14GB.
kevin: ok, that points to the allocator change being the delta. Can we pin alloc=opt-level-2 for this model or add a runtime fallback?
maria: low-risk mitigation: add a model-route config that sets alloc=opt-level-2 for prod-v2 while we investigate. I can open a config PR and include the bench artifacts.
Sam: sounds good. hold merge of #8321 until config PR is ready + bench artifacts attached. We require 2 approvals for merge.
kevin: I can +1 once the config PR is up and the canary artifacts are linked.
Linh: will open config PR in ~30m and attach job logs + flamegraphs. Thanks for the quick triage :tada:
Sam: thanks all — keeping merge on hold. Please ping here when config PR is posted.
Sam: (also posting a small reminder: if we change default allocator we should add a short note in release-notes and the model catalog entry)
Linh: agreed. will add release-note blurb.
Sam: ping me when PR is open and I'll review.
kevin: thanks — nice catch by the canary system.
Linh: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8330 — config patch + artifacts attached. Asking for quick review/approval.
Sam: LGTM after confirming artifacts. :+1:
kevin: +1 (ok to roll forward, config route + bench artifacts look good)
Linh: merging once CI passes. Appreciate the speedy help! :rocket:
